verdict.rationale: Gusto publishes an official, Apache-2.0 CLI (github.com/Gusto/gusto-cli) designed explicitly for agents. It offers --agent/--json stable envelopes, documented exit codes, --dry-run, and a human-in-the-loop --confirm write gate. It also ships a first-party AGENTS.md, a verified install endpoint on cli.gusto.com, regular tagged releases, bundled agent skills for Claude Code, Cursor and others, and headless token auth for CI. missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of real-world use, and maturity beyond v0.x (it is pre-1.0, has no payroll run/submit command, and supports Windows only via WSL2).
